newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ferrotec shares hit lowest level ever.
newsitem.headline: Ferrotec shares hit lowest level ever.

text.p: Shares of Japan's Ferrotec Corp fell to their lowest level ever in Tokyo trade on Thursday after the company revised downward its earnings forecast, brokers said.

As of 0457 GMT, the shares were trading at 1,620 yen, the lowest since they were registered on the over-the-counter market in October last year. The previous record low was 1,650 yen. The shares last traded at 1,900 yen on Wednesday.

On Wednesday, the manufacturer of magnetic fluid products lowered its 1996/97 forecast for parent current profits to 397 million yen from its earlier estimate of 542 million yen. It said it plans to pay an ordinary dividend of five yen per share and a commemorative dividend of two yen for the year.
In 1995/96, it paid an ordinary dividend of 50 yen per share.
